ScreenMethodConfig: Screening Method Configuration

Source: R/04c-ClassMethodCache.R
ScreenMethodConfig.Rd

ScreenMethodConfig stores the configuration for a phenotype-associated cell screening method. It is used both to define screening parameters and as a cache result descriptor.

Usage

ScreenMethodConfig(
  method_name,
  param,
  method_version = NULL,
  phenotype_class = c("binary", "continuous", "survival"),
  label_type = character(0L),
  sigbridger_version = get_pkg_version()
)

Arguments

method_name

character. The name of the screening method (e.g., "Scissor", "scPAS"). Must match a key in ScreenStrategy.

param

list. A named list of parameters passed to the screening function. Must be non-empty.

method_version

character or NULL. The version of the underlying software package. When NULL, automatically resolved via r_pkg_version(method_name).

phenotype_class

character. The phenotype classification type(s). One or more of "binary", "continuous", "survival". Default: all three.

label_type

character. The label type for the screening method. Default: character(0L).

sigbridger_version

Package Version of SigBridgeR

Value

A ScreenMethodConfig S7 object.

Details

This class is defined using the S7 object-oriented system and inherits from SigBridgeRBase. It validates that method_name is a registered screening method in ScreenStrategy and that phenotype_class is one of the supported types.

Validator

The class validator enforces:

  • param must be a non-empty named list.

  • phenotype_class must be one or more of "binary", "continuous", "survival".

  • method_name must match a key in ScreenStrategy.

See also

Other S7-Classes: AnnotationMethod(), BenchAccConfig(), BenchConfig(), BenchGSEAConfig(), BenchGeneScoreConfig(), BenchMemoryConfig(), ScreenMethodCache(), ScreenMethodResult()
